tests.title: Works with the example
tests.fail_how: Ordena por inicio y recorre una sola vez.
tests.fail_how_en: Sort by start and walk once.

tests.title: Merges touching and contained intervals
tests.fail_why: No fusiona ventanas que se tocan ([8,10] y [10,12]) o que están contenidas en otra.
tests.fail_how: Condición de fusión: inicio_actual <= fin_de_la_última. Al fusionar usa Math.max del fin: una ventana contenida NO debe achicar el fin.
tests.fail_why_en: It does not merge windows that touch ([8,10] and [10,12]) or windows contained in another.
tests.fail_how_en: Merge condition: current_start <= end_of_last. When merging use Math.max on the end: a contained window must NOT shrink the end.

tests.title: Works when the input is not sorted
tests.fail_why: Asumiste que la entrada viene ordenada. No lo dice el enunciado.
tests.fail_how: Arrays.sort(windows, Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0])) como primer paso. Cuesta O(n log n) y es lo que domina la complejidad total.
tests.fail_why_en: You assumed the input is sorted. The statement does not say so.
tests.fail_how_en: Arrays.sort(windows, Comparator.comparingInt(a -> a[0])) as the first step. It costs O(n log n) and dominates the total complexity.

tests.title: Handles empty input and a single interval
tests.fail_why: Falla con arreglo vacío o con una sola ventana.
tests.fail_how: if (windows.length == 0) return new int[0][]; y revisa el caso de resultado vacío antes de leer su último elemento.
tests.fail_why_en: Fails with an empty array or a single window.
tests.fail_how_en: if (windows.length == 0) return new int[0][]; and check for an empty result before reading its last element.

tests.title: O(n log n): works with 200,000 intervals in reasonable time
tests.fail_why: Comparar cada ventana con todas las demás es O(n²).
tests.fail_how: Sort + un solo recorrido: O(n log n) tiempo. Tip Java 21: List.getLast() para la última ventana fusionada.
tests.fail_why_en: Comparing every window with all the others is O(n²).
tests.fail_how_en: Sort + a single pass: O(n log n) time. Java 21 tip: List.getLast() for the last merged window.
